# sourdough-glossary

- **autolyse** — resting flour and water together before adding the starter, to let gluten develop
  passively
- **bulk ferment** — the first rise, right after mixing, before shaping
- **cold retard** — a slow, cold second rise in the fridge, mostly for flavor and scheduling
  convenience rather than necessity
- **hooch** — the dark liquid that appears on a hungry starter; see [[Sourdough Hydration]] and the
  starter log for more
- **crumb** — the internal texture of a baked loaf once sliced open
